question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a grey present, Bob has a white present, Claire has a black present, Dave has a pink present, Eve has a blue present, Fred has a brown present, and Gertrude has a purple present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Bob and Fred swap their gifts. Then, Gertrude and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Eve swap their gifts. Then, Fred and Claire swap their gifts. Then, Eve and Claire swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Bob swap their gifts. Finally, Fred and Gertrude swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Bob has the
Options:
(A) grey present
(B) white present
(C) black present
(D) pink present
(E) blue present
(F) brown present
(G) purple present
solution:
Present colors in order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude):
Initial: (grey, white, black, pink, blue, brown, purple)
1. Bob and Fred swap: (grey, brown, black, pink, blue, white, purple)
2. Gertrude and Bob swap: (grey, purple, black, pink, blue, white, brown)
3. Claire and Eve swap: (grey, purple, blue, pink, black, white, brown)
4. Fred and Claire swap: (grey, purple, white, pink, black, blue, brown)
5. Eve and Claire swap: (grey, purple, black, pink, white, blue, brown)
6. Claire and Bob swap: (grey, black, purple, pink, white, blue, brown)
7. Fred and Gertrude swap: (grey, black, purple, pink, white, brown, blue)
Bob has the black present, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
